adapter.batch_size_semantics: args is the architecture template; actual batch size is the runner budget
adapter.compatibility: unmodified native computational AST; local jax.tree_map alias
adapter.composition: unified TD3+BC: actor first, two critic steps on same batch, then target updates
adapter.normalization: train observations: native mean and std plus 0.001 in model

runtime.constraint_check_scope: JAX and NumPy upper bounds only; other upstream requirements are not certified

adapter.sampling: v6 runner samples once; internal sampler boundary is identity; native RNG split retained
adapter.seed_mapping: JAX high and low 32-bit key words
